text: The dashboard can post @gitdek's commands from `/act`: answers to questions, ratify, retry and revise. Cloudflare Access lets only his email into `/act`: team `puglisij`, application `Invariant act`, policy `Only me`. The server also checks Access's signed token on every request: RS256 against the team's published keys, the application's audience, the team as issuer, unexpired, and an allowed email. So a policy that's missing or wrong lets nobody in. A command posts through the dashboard's `gh` login, so on GitHub it's his own comment. `/act` accepts only what an issue is waiting for, and only from the page itself. A ratify or a retry asks first. The rest of the page stays public and only reads. @gitdek chose this over a page that works only on his laptop and over staying read-only, set up Access with the agent, and made the first ratification through it, on #13.
